roles.anyone: Anyone with a funded wallet. Pays only the transaction fee (and its own token account's rent when it buys for the first time); chooses no price.
roles.trader: Anyone, acting on their OWN wallet only: spends their own SOL or sells their own tokens, at the curve formula's price, within the slippage bound they set.
roles.pair_creator: The creator recorded in BOTH mints' burn_receipts TokenConfigs (initialize_token is mint-signed, so this is the launcher). Holds no power after init_pair; receives the rent of the accounts close_pair closes.

instructions.name: buy
instructions.can: While Open and before the deadline: pay F(sold + t) − F(sold) plus the 100 bps fee for t tokens of one side (the largest t the budget affords, capped at the curve supply); the fee goes 25 bps to the developer wallet recorded at init (or to the burn pool if that wallet cannot hold it) and 75 bps to that mint's burn_receipts fee PDA.
instructions.cannot: Buy after the deadline, during or after graduation, or after a void; pay any other recipient; move anyone else's funds; change the price formula.
instructions.funds: Buyer → SOL vault (curve cost), → developer wallet (25 bps), → burn pool (75 bps); token vault → buyer (tokens).

instructions.name: close_pair
instructions.can: When nothing is owed (Graduated with empty token vaults, or Voided with every curve token sold back — then the returned supplies are burned): send the SOL vault's lamports above its rent minimum to the two burn pools, close the token vaults and the Pair with their rent to the recorded creator.
instructions.cannot: Close while tokens are in circulation on a voided pair, while graduating, or while any SOL is owed; send residue anywhere but the burn pools; send rent anywhere but the creator who paid it.
instructions.funds: SOL vault residue → burn pools; account rent → the creator.

instructions.name: graduate
instructions.can: Once per side. The first call (combined raise ≥ target, each side ≥ its minimum share, before the deadline) commits the pair and closes both curves. Each call wraps that side's raise less CPMM's fee and rents, creates the side's Raydium CPMM pool at the pair_curve PDA ["pool", pair, [side]] with the vault as creator and the pinned AmmConfig, at the curve's last price, burns 100 % of the LP and every token the pool did not need, and sends rent refunds and dust to the side's burn pool.
instructions.cannot: Graduate before the condition holds or after the deadline (first call); pick the amounts, the price, the pool address or the AmmConfig; keep any LP; send SOL anywhere but the pool, CPMM's fee/rents and the burn pool; leave the vault re-assigned or a vault token account delegated or close-authorised (re-checked after the CPI, hard errors).
instructions.funds: SOL vault → its WSOL account → the side's CPMM pool (and CPMM's create-pool fee + rents); token vault → the pool; LP → burned; leftover tokens → burned; residue → the side's burn pool.

instructions.name: init_pair
instructions.can: Create the ONE Pair of two fresh mints (zero supply, 6 decimals, no freeze authority, mint authority = the pair's SOL vault PDA) whose TokenConfigs are burn_receipts policy 2 with the same pinned LaunchLab platform and cpConfigId: fix the curve parameters, the combined target, the minimum side share and the deadline (all validated, never writable again); mint 1,000,000,000 of each coin into its token vault and revoke the mint authority; read the developer wallet from the pinned platform.
instructions.cannot: Run twice for a pair or ever again on the same mints (they have no mint authority afterwards); be run by anyone but the recorded creator; choose the fee, its recipients, the AmmConfig or the burn pools; keep any token or any authority.
instructions.funds: Payer → the Pair, the two token vaults (rent) and the SOL vault's rent minimum.

instructions.name: sell
instructions.can: While Open (also after the deadline) and after a void: return t tokens of one side for F(sold) − F(sold − t) less the 100 bps fee (same split). If the second side's pool is blocked for 3 days after graduation started, that side's holders may sell too.
instructions.cannot: Sell once graduation has started (except the stuck-second-side rule); sell more than the curve sold; receive more than the formula; touch the other side's SOL.
instructions.funds: Seller → token vault (tokens); SOL vault → seller (proceeds less fee), → developer wallet, → burn pool.

instructions.name: void_pair
instructions.can: At or after the deadline, if graduation never started: mark the pair Voided — buys stay closed, sells stay open on the same curves so every holder can exit to the SOL vault.
instructions.cannot: Void before the deadline, a graduating or graduated pair, or twice; move any funds.

non_powers: No admin, authority, owner or operator field exists in the program; no instruction takes a privileged signer after init_pair.
No instruction updates a pair's parameters (virtual reserves, curve supply, target, minimum share, deadline, fee, fee recipients, AmmConfig) after init_pair.

No withdraw, sweep or transfer-out instruction exists for the SOL vault or the token vaults. SOL leaves the vault only as a seller's formula proceeds, the fee legs (fixed recipients, formula amounts), the CPMM deposit at graduation (formula amounts, LP burned in the same instruction) and residue to the burn pools.
No pause or freeze exists. Buys end at the deadline; nothing can stop sells on an open or voided pair.
No mint authority survives init_pair and no freeze authority ever exists; the program never mints after init.
The pair program never holds burn-pool money: the 75 bps go straight to the burn_receipts fee PDA in the trade itself.
The developer wallet cannot block a trade: when it could not hold its slice (below rent), the slice goes to the burn pool.

upgrade_authority.power: Program upgrade authority (BPF Upgradeable Loader) — outside the IDL, the one power above all of this.
upgrade_authority.holder_at_launch: The same Squads v4 2-of-3 multisig vault and time lock as burn_receipts (docs/burnticker/runbook.md "Pair program gates").
upgrade_authority.sunset: Set to none (`solana program set-upgrade-authority <PROGRAM_ID> --final`, through the multisig) on the same finalisation plan as burn_receipts.

external_powers.can: Change the pinned AmmConfig's create-pool fee or disable pool creation on it; upgrade the CPMM program.
external_powers.effect: Before the first graduate: graduation can fail (InsufficientPoolSol / CPMM refusal) and the pair voids at its deadline — every holder can sell back. Between the two sides: the second side waits; after 3 days its holders may sell back on its curve. A hostile CPMM upgrade cannot re-assign the vault or its token accounts or take more than the pool costs (post-CPI checks; tests/lifecycle.rs with mocks/evil_cpmm_init).

external_powers.holder: the key that created the pinned LaunchLab platform
external_powers.can: Change platformClaimFeeWallet and cpConfigId on the platform.
external_powers.effect: None on an existing pair: init_pair copies the developer wallet and the cpConfigId (from the TokenConfigs' pins) into the Pair.
